pages.text: $(italic)Aggressive, hungry, and hits like a falling anvil. Orcs excel in sustained melee at the cost of resource drain.$()$(br2)$(bold)Ferocity$(): +12% attack speed. Pairs especially well with Berserker's Blood Fury.$(br2)$(bold)Knockback Mastery$(): +30% knockback dealt, so enemies you hit stagger further. Useful for crowd control.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Hunger Drain$(): +35% food drain rate, the highest penalty in the pack. Always eat before fights.$(br2)$(bold)Brutish$(): immune to the Weakness potion effect, and Slowness lasts half as long on you.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Berserker or Samurai and keep a food bar hotkeyed. You'll burn through it.$()
